name: SLUGBERT
tagline: Slow, wet, and already where you were about to stand.
description: A green slug drawn in thick green marker on cream paper, facing right. A tall domed body rises from a wide, wavy, flattened foot that spreads out low at both sides into two pointed tips, each tip darkened a deeper green. On the upper right side of the body is a deep sideways U-shaped notch, forming an overhanging lip like a mouth or snout. Two thin black eyestalks rise from the top of the head, the right one leaning right more than the left; each ends in a black-outlined oval eye with a blue pupil in the upper-right corner, so both eyes look up and to the right. The body is covered in markings: 5 green ovals/rings (one at top, one small filled blob upper left, one small ring mid-body, two larger rounded-square rings side by side lower down) and 8 short green dashes scattered over the lower body and sides. No arms, no legs.
card: SPECIAL  Slime trail: you glide, they slip
UP+SPECIAL  Stretch up, sticky foot latches
GRAB  Swallow, then spit them out
